posts.text: Makes sense. OS level age gating is a whooooooooole different beast

Thanks for the info!

I can see how they’re trying to use it as a supporting argument. I guess it just reads like normal spin to me, but what’ll really be illuminating is how the appeals court handles it and if any further clarification is made

Are things perhaps getting mixed up a bit here? These rulings aren’t really a part of the OS-level age verification discussion as far as I can tell. There may be Dem politicians likening the two but the two big lawsuits that just landed were pretty different

It’ll be in tomorrow’s SKH but curious

Especially because it’s absolutely true that these apps are being designed with intent to be addictive and to adhere as minimally to regulation as possible 

SV product managers exist to make a big number for a quarter or two by bending the rules, then leaving to be VP elsewhere

I’ll have to spend some time putting my thoughts together on all this for a video / essay thing sometime because it’s really, genuinely difficult to fully convey my thoughts on this since it starts with “what should the internet even be” and things can fall apart quickly from there

I’m not a legal expert, but I am a tech, UGC, and user app design/development expert

I don’t believe that section 230 as it stands leads to a healthier internet

I understand the alarm and concern for what comes next but most of that is already here while also shielding the worst offenders

My honest take here is that websites should be liable for the content they profit from

This piece feels like a lot of slippery slope fallacies mixed with what seems like an intentionally narrow view of the verdict
One of those “photos to summarize the year” contenders, but like, perennially
"I know you’re getting my emails" is a very bad way to get me to reply to your "strategic partnership" propositions

I accidentally deleted a font from my computer

I’ve deleted fonts before but never accidentally

like, I dont recall deleting any fonts, but it was gone

got it back but like what??
weird how when I do tasks ahead of time, it’s easier when the time comes for those tasks to be due

Remember to meet people and continue the work afterwards if you're going to protests today

The best takeaway from mass protests such as these are the connections and show of solidarity. Exchange info and connect locally with like minded folks.
